notes: Posted 12 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, A Million Voices Crying Out, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Death Star; these count toward the 60. The three Effects are the Prepared Defenses Effects; none is named as the single starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'Red(20)' is the section header for the 20 Interrupts/Effects (not a card). Two-sided systems/sites dested the Dark pages: Alderaan (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark) (posted 'Death Star DB'), Endor (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark) (posted 'Kashyyk').

Posted 'There Is No Try/Opp Enf' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Moby Points' dested Mobilization Points; 'We're in Attack Position' dested We're In Attack Position Now; 'Adm Piet' dested Admiral Piett; 'Vader w/Saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'U3P0' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Twi'lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Something Special Planned' dested Something Special Planned For Them. Come Here You Big Coward and Secret Plans are 2001 Effects, counted in the 60.

Posted under 'Extra Card That Doesn't Count Against Deck Size (1)': Hyperoute Navigation Chart, a parsec-tracking game aid outside the 60; the wiki has only the current Virtual Set P page for it, so it is not listed as a card.
The P.S. says Justin Alfs was to play this deck at Mirkwood 'with the mandatory 6 cards changed'; no result is given.
